findings.title: View target file before every edit
findings.summary: The specialist issued an edit without first confirming the current target file state.
findings.expected_impact: Eliminates stale-base edits and reduces review-cycle churn.
findings.prompt_fragment: Before issuing any edit, view the target file to confirm its current content.

findings.title: Confirm lane scope before delegation
findings.summary: The task crossed into an adjacent specialist lane without surfacing the boundary.
findings.expected_impact: Reduces mid-run rerouting and keeps specialist work bounded.
findings.prompt_fragment: Before implementation, identify adjacent specialist lanes and ask for routing confirmation.
